class.name: InterDVDButton
class.brief_description: A PCI HLI highlight plus a domain-validated 8-byte DVD-Video command.
class.description: Menus and titles may have up to 36 buttons. Set [member action] to a hardware destination and [member target], [member title_n], or [member stream] as needed. The inspector lists named titles and video cells from [code]blazium/inter_dvd/project[/code]. [method resolve_command] encodes through [InterDVDInstruction]: Jump Title is JumpTT from the VMGM and LinkPGCN from a title; Jump Chapter is LinkPTT or JumpVTS_PTT; Jump Menu ids 2-7 are JumpSS or CallSS. JumpSS from the title domain is illegal. There is no URL, file, or app launch — a video file on disc is a muxed VOB cell reached by JumpTT / LinkPTT.

method.name: resolve_command
method.description: Returns the 8-byte hardware command for [param domain] ([constant DOMAIN_VMGM] or [constant DOMAIN_VTST]).

method.name: sync_highlight_from_scene
method.description: Copies [member highlight] from the [CanvasItem] at [member control_path] (Control rect or Node2D [code]get_rect()[/code]). If the node is missing, uses [param default_highlight] only when that rect has area. Clamps to 720×480 even HLI edges and [param title_safe_bottom] (or ProjectSettings when [code]-1[/code]).

constants.constant: Play Title: JumpTT ([code]30 02[/code]) from the menu domain, or LinkPGCN ([code]20 04[/code]) from a title.
JumpSS ([code]30 06[/code]) from the menu domain, or CallSS ([code]30 08[/code]) from a title. Menu ids: Title 2, Root 3, Subpicture 4, Audio 5, Angle 6, Chapter 7.
LinkPGCN ([code]20 04[/code]) to [member target] in the current domain.
Play Chapter: LinkPTT from a title, or JumpVTS_PTT from the VMGM using [member title_n] and [member target].
RSM. Legal only from a menu domain.
